title: Three-stage Cayley covers for conditional kappa = 3.146011e-4 > 2^-12
body:
This extends my [PR #115](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/115) at `cf60442983c153a3a0f5272ea4713f99eba13c86`, with one new commit. The #10 → #18 → #24 → #32 → merged #36 → #104 → #115 proof lineage and attributed ordinary-leaf, semantic/bulk and fixed-tape interfaces are retained.

Under the retained multiplication framework and those analytic/tape interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{3146011}{10000000000}=3.146011\times10^{-4}.
$$

## Construction

The global architecture uses three invocation banks on a regular Cayley cover in dimension `3h-2`. Each local port retains its source line while the three active spaces exchange its complement with two separate blocks. The actual data frames agree at both stage boundaries. Three signed shears complete the interchange, so there are no positive-width data connectors or copied rank-one endpoint corrections. All three local words, arbitrary dirty cleanup, copied centers and auxiliary exteriors remain charged. The per-vertex rank deficit is `2v-3ell`, with `2v+3R` persistent roles.

The complex supplier adopts **eumemic**'s PR #117 h24 positive DAG, with 91,770 additions, 71,185 compatible carrier links and 28,705 auxiliary roles. A new Clifford frame theorem applies to every binary subspace, including degenerate intersections and partial gauges. Exact representatives use preimage Lagrangians; actual rank-zero adapters reconcile frames before scalar gates. The local verifier rebuilds full backward intersections and 4,599 source gauges, with readouts executed in reverse selection order.

The complex cover is `O(70,2)`. Its full order, finite routers and scalar operations remain in the semantic certificate. The per-vertex inventory has 90,163 roles, rank 6,309,018 and deficit 2,392. The strict complex saving is `786999/2500000000`, with moment gap exceeding `2.3047018455e-10`. Exact denominator-21 decoding and the completed-child `C1=1` contract are retained.

The bit supplier uses the unchanged **Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen)** PR #97 physical ledger based on **Swapnil Jain**'s witness. Its dimension is 67. A finite `GL_67(Z/q^w)` cover batches high matrix digits by fixed low-residue types. Unit-lower factorization leaves variable pivot units inside weighted reversed children. Nongeneric classes receive a full local-ring Gaussian fallback of at most `32m^2` proper children; its entire extra moment is charged on a fraction `10^-16` of every ideal edge. The coarse saving is `747/2000000`, with certified contaminated gap exceeding `6.3397366396e-7`; stopping gives ordinary bit saving `3731649599/10000000000000`.

The bit selector stock occupies `O(w log e)` original address digits and is restored by an explicit outer ordinary-interchange wrapper. Its uniform batching, weighted leaves, fallback, atom adapters, borrowed-row restoration and binary padding are included in the proof. The complex and conservative legacy reserves use external stock `p^160000`, with coefficient 68,505. All 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins hold, with final absorption gap exceeding `3.4173577301e-12`.

Baker–Harman–Pintz supplies the prime-interval theorem used by the adopted packing argument. Historical AI-assistance disclosures are preserved. The table records construction dependencies and contribution scope; independently published exponent savings are not added together.

## Proof and attribution

- `notes/three-stage-cover-note.tex`: selected cover construction, weighted compiler, row restoration and final assembly, supplied as LaTeX source.
- `notes/general-clifford-frames.tex`: exact representatives, nested transitions, arbitrary source gauges and complete reverse/complement words.
- `scripts/three_stage_cover_producer.py`: pinned PR #117 DAG reconstruction, generalized frames and independent physical-word checks.
- `scripts/three_stage_cover_network.py` and `certificates/three-stage-cover-network.json`: full inventories, contaminated bit moment, finite complex group/router charge and exact assembly.
- `references/three-stage-cover/pr117/`: original positive DAG, replay, source pins, notices and license.

The result remains conditional on the retained analytic/tape interfaces, constructive setup and eventual thresholds. Finite checks do not formally verify the complete theorem. The finite group is specified mathematically and is not materialized by the verifier; uniform q-adic batching and row borrowing are written proof dependencies. Earlier submitted code, source-specific licenses and upstream review records are preserved.

The generalized Clifford theorem, three-stage geometry, weighted cover, rare-class compiler and internal-row construction are contributed by **icekylinx**, with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra assistance. Repository integration uses Codex assistance. Adopted authorship and assistance disclosures remain in `SOURCES.json`, `NOTICE` and the preserved snapshots. Existing Apache-2.0 and imported CC0 terms apply to their respective sources. Unselected reclaim branches, alternative covers, research motifs, large generated graphs and PDFs are excluded.

## Validation

- Verified the supplied base archive and consumed dependency hashes.
- Rebuilt the new PR #117 local DAG, matching, full subspace intersections, physical word and source gauges. Every selected profile field matched.
- Independently checked scalar supports and signs, divisor 21, old-frame containment, full dependency/carrier intersections, actual frame transitions, center closure, untouched source roles, reverse target chains and positive-rank accounting.
- Reconstructed the retained bit local ranks from pinned physical paths, then rebuilt both three-stage inventories and certified strict moments, full rare-class charge, stopped saving and subordinate adapter/row tolls.
- Recomputed the complete finite complex group/router charge, exact semantic guard, external row reserve, 47 strict inequalities and seven assembly margins.
- Refreshed shared source hashes and dependent joint-dual certificate digests; recomputed joint arithmetic and confirmed unchanged mathematical fields and prior replay payload.
- Checked staged source bindings and deterministic certificate regeneration. Proof sources are included; no PDF compilation was performed.

Unchanged prior producer and full historical suites were not rerun. The incremental command is `make three-stage-cover-verify`; its scope is documented in `docs/three-stage-cover.md`.
